title: MeloTwo Zambian Mining & Environmental Regulatory Ruleset
description: Statutory rule configuration integrating the Mines and Minerals Development Act No. 11 of 2015, the Mining Regulations (MSR), and ZEMA Environmental Management Regulations for subterranean hazard enforcement and local contractor onboarding.

regulatory_authorities.name: Mines Safety Department
regulatory_authorities.ministry: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development
regulatory_authorities.statutory_act: Mines and Minerals Development Act No. 11 of 2015 / Mining Regulations (MSR)

regulatory_authorities.name: Zambia Environmental Management Agency
regulatory_authorities.ministry: Ministry of Green Economy and Environment
regulatory_authorities.statutory_act: Environmental Management Act No. 12 of 2011 & Statutory Instrument No. 112

regulatory_authorities.name: Medical Bureau for Occupational Diseases (Silicosis Bureau)
regulatory_authorities.statutory_act: Occupational Health and Safety Act No. 36 of 2010

regulatory_authorities.name: Workers' Compensation Fund Control Board
regulatory_authorities.ministry: Ministry of Labour and Social Security

subterranean_hazards.title: Subterranean Hazards & Mining Safety Regulations (MSR)
subterranean_hazards.statutory_basis: Mining Regulations (MSR), Parts IX, XII, and XIV (Underground Working, Electricity, Explosives & Ventilation)

rules.name: Methane (CH4) Flammable Gas Thresholds

enforcement_protocol.on_warning: Log alert on MeloTwo PWA, initiate auxiliary ventilation boost, notify Section Ventilation Officer.
enforcement_protocol.on_power_trip: Automated interlock disconnects electrical feeder to section.
enforcement_protocol.on_evacuation: Immediate withdrawal of all personnel from heading to fresh-air base; entry barricaded with red statutory warning notice.

rules.name: Carbon Monoxide (CO) Toxic Gas Thresholds

enforcement_protocol.on_alert: Don Self-Contained Self-Rescuers (SCSRs) if CO > 50 ppm.
enforcement_protocol.on_ceiling: Immediate section shutdown; investigate post-blast lingering fumes or smoldering timber/conveyor belt.

rules.name: Oxygen (O2) Deficiency Minimum

enforcement_protocol.on_deficiency: No entry permitted under 19.5% O2; red tag entry and activate secondary fresh air line.

rules.name: Minimum Air Velocity in Underground Working Faces

enforcement_protocol.on_sub_minimum: Halt drilling/loading activities until auxiliary ducting is inspected and fan volume verified.

rules.name: Underground Geotechnical Ground Support & Rock Bolt Integrity
rules.statutory_reference: MSR Part X, Reg 1008 (Excavations & Support of Workings)

enforcement_protocol.on_failure: Condemn unsupported advance face; install temporary hydraulic props before secondary bolting.

rules.name: Subterranean Substation Flameproof Enclosures & Grounding
rules.statutory_reference: MSR Part XII (Electricity in Mines) & SANS 10142-1 Code of Practice

enforcement_protocol.on_exceedance: Lock out high-voltage feed (3.3kV / 550V) until NGR resistor and bonding jumpers are re-tested.

rules.name: Subterranean Blast Clearance & Fume Re-entry Interval
rules.statutory_reference: MSR Part IX, Reg 912 (Handling of Explosives & Blasting Times)

enforcement_protocol.on_premature_entry: Automatic violation flag; revocation of shift entry badge; MSD disciplinary logging.

rules.name: Subterranean Fresh Air Refuge Chamber Operational Readiness
rules.statutory_reference: MSR Part XIV, Emergency Preparedness Directives

enforcement_protocol.on_inspection_deficit: Immediate audit ticket; replenishment of soda-lime scrubber canisters and emergency rations.

zema_environmental_effluent.title: ZEMA Mine Water Discharge & Effluent Licensing Rules
zema_environmental_effluent.statutory_basis: Environmental Management Act No. 12 of 2011 / Statutory Instrument No. 112 (Licensing of Emissions and Effluent)

rules.name: Industrial Effluent & Decant Discharge pH Range

enforcement_protocol.on_breach: Automated shutoff of river discharge weir gate; redirect to neutralizing lime slurry circuit.

rules.name: Total Dissolved Copper (Cu) in Final Discharge

enforcement_protocol.on_breach: Divert stream to retention/settling dam No. 3; audit solvent extraction/electrowinning wash circuit.

rules.name: Total Suspended Solids (TSS)

enforcement_protocol.on_breach: Increase flocculant dosage at thickener overflow ponds; halt discharge into drainage canal.

rules.name: Total Cobalt (Co) in Aquatic Discharge

enforcement_protocol.on_breach: Engage secondary precipitation reactor; notify Kafue Basin water management catchment team.

rules.name: Weak Acid Dissociable (WAD) Cyanide in Tailings Decant
rules.statutory_reference: ZEMA SI 112 Hazardous Waste / Mining Effluent Criteria

enforcement_protocol.on_breach: Activate Caro's acid / sodium metabisulfite detox circuit; halt decant transfer immediately.

rules.name: TSF Embankment Freeboard Margin & Factor of Safety
rules.statutory_reference: ZEMA Environmental Code of Practice for Tailings Dam Safety

enforcement_protocol.on_breach: Mandatory geotechnical audit within 24 hours; cease tailings deposition on affected crest.

rules.name: Secondary Chemical Containment Bunding Capacity

enforcement_protocol.on_deficit: Prohibit bulk reagent offloading (hydrochloric acid, diesel, flotation reagents) until bund integrity is certified.

contractor_onboarding_and_local_content.title: Mines & Minerals Development Act Contractor Onboarding & Local Content
contractor_onboarding_and_local_content.statutory_basis: Mines and Minerals Development Act No. 11 of 2015 & Local Content Statutory Guidelines

rules.name: Citizen-Owned / Influenced Business Equity Requirement
rules.statutory_reference: Mines and Minerals Development (General) Regulations, Local Content Framework
mandatory_verification_documents: PACRA (Patents and Companies Registration Agency) Certified Shareholding Structure
National Registration Cards (NRC) of Zambian Citizen Directors
Zambia Chamber of Mines Contractor Accreditation

enforcement_protocol.on_non_compliance: Contractor locked out from Tier-1 mining house supply tenders; classified as Non-Compliant Expatriate Entity.

rules.name: Zambian National Workforce Quota
rules.statutory_reference: Mines and Minerals Development Act No. 11 of 2015, Part IV (Employment and Training)
mandatory_verification_documents: Certified Monthly Staff Payroll / NAPSA Schedule
Approved Succession Plan for any Expatriate Engineering Roles
Department of Immigration Expatriate Work Permits

enforcement_protocol.on_deficit: Block site gate pass clearances until workforce ratios reflect statutory quotas.

rules.name: Mandatory Zambian Statutory Registrations

mandatory_credentials.validity_check: Active status with annual returns lodged
Valid within current fiscal tax period
Workers' Compensation fund contributions paid to date

enforcement_protocol.on_missing_credential: Immediate hard onboarding block. No site access or tender dossier compilation permitted.

rules.name: MSD Statutory Competency Licenses & Legal Appointments

mandatory_appointment_categories.statutory_license: Engineering Institution of Zambia (EIZ) Registered & ERB Practicing License
MSD Approved Mine Safety Officer Certification

enforcement_protocol.on_expired_license: Contractor barred from high-risk subterranean activities until renewals are stamped by MSD Kitwe.

rules.name: Medical Bureau for Occupational Diseases (Silicosis) Fitness Certificate
mandatory_checks: Baseline Chest X-Ray (ILO Classification for pneumoconiosis / silicosis)
Active MBOD Fit-for-Duty Certificate (Valid for 12 months)
rules.statutory_reference: Occupational Health and Safety Act & Mines Regulations MBOD Protocol

enforcement_protocol.on_unfit_result: Immediate subterranean work restriction; reassignment to low-dust surface operations.

rules.name: MeloTwo 20-Section Zambian Mining Tender Safety File
required_dossier_sections: Section 1: Company Profile, PACRA, ZRA TPIN, ZEMA Permits
Section 2: Mines Safety Department (MSD) Legal Appointments & Organogram
Section 3: Occupational Health & Safety Policy (OHS Act / MSR Compliant)
Section 4: Baseline Risk Assessments (HIRA) & Issue-Based JSA
Section 5: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for Subterranean Advance
Section 6: Fall of Ground & Strata Management Plan
Section 7: Flammable Gas & Atmospheric Monitoring Procedures
Section 8: Electrical & Lockout Tagout (LOTO) Procedures (SANS 10142)
Section 9: Explosives Handling, Transport & Blasting Permits (Form MSD-14)
Section 10: TSF Decant & Effluent Environmental Management Plan (ZEMA SI 112)
Section 11: Waste Management & Hazardous Chemicals Register
Section 12: Incident Notification & MSD Section 54/55 Response Plan
Section 13: Emergency Preparedness & Underground Refuge Chamber Protocol
Section 14: Medical Surveillance & MBOD Silicosis Certificates
Section 15: PPE Issue Register & Specification Compliance Matrix
Section 16: Training Records, Induction Log & Competency Certificates
Section 17: Machinery & Trackless Mobile Machinery (TMM) Pre-use Checklists
Section 18: Workers' Compensation (WCFCB) & NAPSA Clearance Certificates
Section 19: Internal SHEQ Audit Schedule & Inspection Records
Section 20: Contractor Sign-off, Statutory Declarations & Client Acceptance

enforcement_protocol.on_compile: Export audit-ready cryptographically stamped PDF dossier in under 90 seconds via MeloTwo engine.
